children: Alimentation Couche-Tard's "merchandising agility" and "rationalization of promotions" are driving U.S. market-share gains and multiyear-high margins despite softer consumer demand. The momentum keeps the convenience-store operator positioned for upside ahead of its Dec. 7 Zabka acquisition close, Stifel analyst Martin Landry says. Stifel maintains a buy rating and C$102 price target after 2Q U.S. same-store merchandise sales rose 1.8%, outpacing 7-Eleven's 0.3%, while U.S. merchandise margin tied a five-year high at 34.8% as management pivots toward "protein-rich products" and pares back deep meal discounts. Although Landry trims 2H U.S. same-store sales forecasts to 2.0% amid tougher comparisons, he expects Couche-Tard to reach full Zabka ownership by mid-2027, noting it still has "appetite to continue consolidating the industry." (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
